body:
Can someone reproduce this ?

In the next few days I will also try to upgrade to **2.5.4** and see if the problem persists.
Can't reproduce this with `Doctrine\DBAL\Types\*`. Please try writing a failing test case.

@Ocramius I also tried it with a connection that uses OCI8 driver and it behaves exactly the same.

I will try to do some debugging sometime in next few days, maybe I'll narrow it down to only a few statements/types/etc.
@SoboLAN is this supposed to be closed? What's the resolution?

@Ocramius I closed it because I don't have an Oracle database available with which I can try to to reproduce it.

Given the monstruosity of typical Oracle stuff (because #corporate-bs ), I doubt I'll be able to install something like that.

@SoboLAN fully understand, but if this is happening, and can be isolated to a unit test (without a running OracleDB instance), then please try to do so.

Marking this as `incomplete`.
This thread has been automatically locked since there has not been any recent activity after it was closed. Please open a new issue for related bugs.
